FeatureCellShape<T>

A FeatureCell exposes a stable runtime surface defined by the FeatureCellShape<T> contract. This shape represents the complete public interaction surface for configuring behaviors, observing state, and issuing state updates after registration.

FeatureCellShape Contract Summary

  • Defines the complete public runtime API of a FeatureCell
  • Available only after FeatureCell registration
  • Used to configure behaviors during initialization
  • Used to observe state and lifecycle events
  • Used to issue state updates and control lifecycle

FeatureCellShape<T> does not describe pipeline internals, execution mechanics, or behavior implementation. It defines only the externally visible interaction surface exposed by a registered FeatureCell.

Note

A FeatureCellShape instance is returned by provideFeatureCell() and becomes active only after initialization. All methods on this shape are scoped to the owning FeatureCell and operate within the globally initialized Vault runtime.
